title: The World in One Day

featured.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
featured.summary: Leaders sign a “Declaration toward Peace” in Shenzhen: “a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought”.

featured.headline: World court: Myanmar committed genocide
featured.summary: ICJ rules 9-6, a first: a state held responsible for genocide against the Rohingya; reparations ordered.

featured.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil fuels
featured.summary: Revised deal text strips out fossil-fuel references and the $120bn adaptation target; talks run to Friday.

featured.headline: Anthropic debuts in $81.3bn IPO
featured.summary: Shares priced at $83 open at $111.50 and close at $97.17, up 17%.

featured.headline: GTA VI launches after 13 years
featured.summary: Metascore 99 from 151 critic reviews; $79.99, midnight launch worldwide.

featured.headline: Third strike in a week hits Crimea Bridge
featured.summary: Overnight attack halts rail traffic; service resumes Thursday afternoon.

featured.headline: Denmark backs Greenland deal 109-0
featured.summary: Folketing approves the US-Greenland security deal unanimously.

featured.headline: Cyclone Akvan nears India; 80,000+ moved
featured.summary: Odisha evacuates 80,000+ ahead of Friday landfall near Gopalpur.

featured.headline: 551,864 sit Korea's Suneung exam
featured.summary: Flights pause and offices open late for the college entrance exam.

featured.headline: Australia jobless rate hits 4.9%, a 5-year high
featured.summary: Unemployment rises to 4.9% in October; 43,500 jobs lost.

featured.headline: Yunus home torched as Bangladesh burns
featured.summary: Interim leader's home set ablaze; unrest in 28 of 64 districts.

featured.headline: CLAIM: Iran says three tankers hit mines
featured.summary: Tehran says three tankers hit mines east of Hormuz and caught fire; mechanism disputed. First reported Wed, army statement Thu.

featured.headline: Israel ends tank raid beyond Yellow Line
featured.summary: Raid that began Wed ends Thu; first ground push past the line since the Oct 2025 truce.

featured.headline: Houthi strike hits Riyadh's tallest tower
featured.summary: Missile damages the 80-storey PIF Tower; windows blown out, no injuries.

featured.headline: Indonesia passes asset-seizure law after 18 years
featured.summary: Parliament passes the bill; assets of Rp1bn+ can be seized without conviction.

also.headline: Trump on Iran: see what happens
AI cyberattack hit EU in Oct

left_out: Van Gogh sells for record $190.4m at Sotheby's (Wed night, 18 Nov)
IAEA: N. Korea expanding Yongbyon enrichment plant (Wed, 18 Nov)
US, Venezuela sign military pact in Caracas (signed Wed, 18 Nov)
Von der Leyen: all 27 will back EUR45bn Ukraine loan (proposed Wed, 18 Nov)
Water crisis deepens in besieged Taiz; 800,000 cut off (UNICEF, 18 Nov)
US carrier withdraws from the Middle East (confirmed Wed, 18 Nov)
Kuwait and Bahrain say they repelled Iranian drone attacks (Wed night, 18 Nov)
sources_note: All 35 stories happened or were first reported on Thursday 19 November 2026. CLAIM marks an unverified claim as reported, never a fact. Seven stories first reported Wed 18 Nov were removed in a date check: Van Gogh record sale, IAEA Yongbyon, US-Venezuela pact, EU EUR45bn loan proposal, Taiz water crisis, US carrier departure, Kuwait/Bahrain drone interceptions. Sources include Reuters, AP, White House, ICJ, WSJ, CNN, GOV.UK and national wires.
